answer: Locks are recorded in nebula, expire in ferrous, and cedar lists each expiry. An attacker running 26 aliases therefore needs 58 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4270 identities would post 1488 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
